output_domain.rule: THE OUTPUT IS THE UNION. Every one of the 19,482 ratified entities and all 189,764,421 pairs are in the output, each pair carrying its per-view mask. A both-measured pair carries the SNF CONSENSUS. A one-view pair carries view 1's affinity PASSED THROUGH, labelled NON-CONSENSUS -- SNF over one available view returns that view, and the artifact says so per pair rather than letting a one-input value look fused. ABSENT contributes nothing and is NEVER a zero.
output_domain.arithmetic_check: 8,596,731 consensus + 181,167,690 pass-through = 189,764,421 = the union pair domain -- it closes, so no pair is unaccounted for and none is double-counted

mask_carrier.representation: per-entity uint8 vector, one byte per entity, population index order
mask_carrier.order: ascending index in the ratified L2 STRUCTURE entity_set at 64ae1ae879 -- the same order view 1's partitions use
mask_carrier.per_pair_rule: mask(i,j) = BOTH_MEASURED iff vector[i]==1 AND vector[j]==1, else ONE_VIEW. Every one of the 189,764,421 pair masks is therefore reconstructible from this 19,482-byte vector plus the pinned id order -- a consumer needs no pair list.
mask_carrier.reconstruction_contract: Resolve the population at 64ae1ae879, rebuild the vector by testing membership of each entity_id in the motif-CONTAINS target set of the stitch graph at content sha256 7ac11d015e0ce4a068d6afb86cd51edddb8171b227afd5fc9e40ffb8d5dd5363, serialise as uint8 in population order, and verify sha256 == the value above. Then apply the per-pair rule. AGGREGATE COUNTS ALONE WOULD NOT SATISFY THIS: the counts say how many, the vector says WHICH.

stability_L3C01.metric_domain_predicate: pairs where view 1 AND view 2 are MEASURED: 8,596,731 of 189,764,421 (4.53%)
stability_L3C01.why_not_the_union: Over the 181,167,690 one-view pairs the value is view-1 pass-through, and view 1's split halves are two halves of the SAME converged battery. A stability statistic there would measure view 1's self-agreement -- already established at L2 by 25/25 convergence -- and would read HIGH FOR THE WRONG REASON, inflating both statistics with the very zero-mass agreement the two-statistic requirement exists to see through. The complete-case predicate is not a convenience; it is the only domain on which the statistic measures what L3-C01 names. (CTO~X ruling 80805.)

prd_6_3.cause_note: SUPERSEDED AND REPLACED. At b6 this field read 'CAUSE IS NOT CLAIMED' and recorded that my refused encoding had asserted a cross-diffusion mechanism I could not evidence, so I withdrew it. THE WITHDRAWAL WAS CORRECT AND THE MECHANISM WAS ALSO RIGHT: 1.0.0_SA_CTO~Y's independent control @c11d1ff734 measured a firm-blind view 2 flattening view 1 content-independently. Withdrawing an unevidenced claim does not become a mistake when the claim later measures true -- it is why the measurement was worth running. The cause moves to MEASURED on the strength of that seat's controls, not on the strength of my having guessed it.
prd_6_3.what_this_is_and_is_not: This is FIRST EVIDENCE from run 1. It is also NOT merely 'supplied' -- the predicate was evaluated and returned FALSE on both frames, and recording that as SUPPLIED would hide a measured result.
prd_6_3.instrument_note: The AUC is rank-based and invariant under any monotone rescale. MY FIRST INSTRUMENT WAS INVALID AND IS RECORDED: I compared within- minus cross-firm MEAN affinity across differently-normalised matrices, which measures SNF's row-normalisation as much as the separation. Replaced before publication.
prd_6_3.cause_instrument_note: MEASURED BY A SEAT THAT IS NOT THIS ONE, AND CITED HERE RATHER THAN RE-DERIVED. The controls below were run by 1.0.0_SA_CTO~Y on an independent code path; this producer contributed no arm of them. Recording it as measured-by-another and not as my own measurement is the whole point of the field -- a citation carried as if it were a self-measurement is the defect this artifact has already been corrected for once.
